usage: ansible-vault create [-h] [--encrypt-vault-id ENCRYPT_VAULT_ID]
                            [--vault-id VAULT_IDS] [-J |
                            --vault-password-file VAULT_PASSWORD_FILES] [-v]
                            [--skip-tty-check]
                            [file_name ...]

positional arguments:
  file_name             Filename

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --encrypt-vault-id ENCRYPT_VAULT_ID
                        the vault id used to encrypt (required if more than
                        one vault-id is provided)
  --vault-id VAULT_IDS  the vault identity to use. This argument may be
                        specified multiple times.
  -J, --ask-vault-password, --ask-vault-pass
                        ask for vault password
  --vault-password-file, --vault-pass-file VAULT_PASSWORD_FILES
                        vault password file
  -v, --verbose         Causes Ansible to print more debug messages. Adding
                        multiple -v will increase the verbosity, the builtin
                        plugins currently evaluate up to -vvvvvv. A reasonable
                        level to start is -vvv, connection debugging might
                        require -vvvv. This argument may be specified multiple
                        times.
  --skip-tty-check      allows editor to be opened when no tty attached
